channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye in contact with Germany for crashed jet’s black box
item.description: Türkiye has engaged in talks with Germany to examine the black box from the private jet crash that killed Libya’s military chief, Turkish Justice Minister Yılmaz Tunç said on Dec. 26.

item.title: Rising sea level in Black Sea poses risk to 160 mln: Study
item.description: The sea level in the Black Sea has risen by around 10 to 12 centimeters over the past three decades, exposing coastal regions and approximately 160 million people living along the basin to growing risks linked to climate change, according to a Turkish academic study.

item.title: Christian communities across Türkiye embrace spirit of Christmas
item.description: From the historic cathedrals of Istanbul to the stone-carved sanctuaries of the southeastern province of Mardin, Christian communities across the country have united this week to mark Christmas with a range of festive celebrations.

item.title: Pashinyan urges ‘more concrete’ steps in Türkiye normalization
item.description: Ankara and Yerevan should move their normalization process into a new phase, Armenian Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan has said, urging the sides to take more tangible steps.

item.title: Türkiye picks climate change minister as COP31 head
item.description: Türkiye has appointed its Environment, Urbanization and Climate Change Minister Murat Kurum as the president of the COP31 climate summit, which will be held in the country in 2026, according to a communique published in the Official Gazette.

item.title: Japan mulls coastal defense collaboration with Türkiye
item.description: The Japanese government has indicated that it could collaborate with Türkiye to utilize the $640 million allocated for coastal defense from its newly approved $58 billion defense budget.

item.title: US launches strikes on ISIL targets in Nigeria
item.description: President Donald Trump said U.S. forces conducted "powerful and deadly" strikes on Dec. 15 against ISIL militants in northwestern Nigeria, weeks after he warned against any systemic assault on Christians in the country.

item.title: Damascus halts talks with SDF, denies progress on integration deal
item.description: The Syrian government has denied reports claiming progress in talks on integrating the YPG-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) into state institutions in Damascus, announcing that the negotiations have in fact been suspended.

item.title: Erdoğan: Türkiye now in 'different league' in health care
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Dec. 26 that Türkiye has entered a "different league" in global health care, asserting that his administration’s reforms have standardized high-quality medical access for all citizens.

item.title: Türkiye to meet 25 percent of energy needs domestically by 2028: Minister
item.description: Türkiye aims to cover a quarter of its energy demand through domestic production by 2028, according to Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar.
